notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
With the latest update, you can now rotate 90 degrees to the left or right in the arena.  There are buttons just to the left of the ice when you first start a game.  Click on either the left or right arrows to rotate either direction.  Hopefully this will allow players to find the optimal direction for their specific gaming setups.

Thanks,
Brian

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

I've gotten a few comments that the stones tend to move too much as they are coming to a stop.  I've made some adjustments to the physics to try and address this.  Please let me know what you think.

Thanks!
Brian
